3 days later,
Just the two of them took a castle
and stole an entire small country.
Their reign, which took no taxes at all,
was greeted by the people with joy.
But a government with no thought for
the job of "ruling a country"
was sure to collapse in no time:
so, in truth, all those around them thought.
But before their rule showed a single crack,
they grew tired of dull castle life.
After a mere 3 months, they walked out of the castle.
And so it was that
"World's Most Troublesome Couple"
became their nickname.
This nickname,
to those in power, was as good as a devil's name,
but to common folk under war and tyranny
it was a true comfort.
"World's Most Troublesome Couple"
would ring around the world for 40 years.
Yes, their legend had only just begun...

After several wars, the Kingdom of Weihnachten
allied with nearly every nation on its borders
and led that alliance.
It then turned its efforts to fostering industry.
Drawn by the dream of a land at peace,
merchants and farmers settled in droves,
and it came to be called the "New Capital of the North."
Then the queen built her city a Royal Academy.
Even in an age of war,
this land brought forth many great scientists and artists.
and the fair young queen and her strategist won world renown.
In old age, the Royal Academy's first head recalled:
"No ruler was so loved by all
or so trusted as my queen.
But no one, I think, believed
in her as I did..."
